criteria.C1_retained_128: arena median retained at cycle 128 < system median, exact two-sided Mann-Whitney p < 0.05, both workloads
criteria.C2_first_open_live: arena median (live at cycle 1 - empty) <= 1.10 x system median, both workloads
criteria.C3_slope_plateau: arena slope <= 4096 bytes/cycle and median late growth <= 524288 bytes, and arena slope <= system slope + 1024, both workloads
criteria.C4_reopen_stable: arena median reopen cost at cycle 128 <= 1.5 x median reopen cost at cycle 8, both workloads
criteria.C5_rss_post_close_128: arena median RSS after the close at cycle 128 <= system median, both workloads
criteria.C6_teardown: zero teardown-check violations in every run of every arm
criteria.C7_capacity: arena median dense-array capacity ratio >= 0.90 x system median
criteria.verdict: court-eligible only if C1..C7 all hold; the default allocator stays unchanged either way and the arena stays opt-in

limitations: one macOS arm64 machine; one target per cycle; two browser workloads plus one synthetic allocator script
the arena's memory.trim marks only the free tail of a live realm reusable; it is not a whole-realm close recovery and is reported as tail-only
the default allocator's post-close retention is libmalloc reservation; leak absence is not claimed for any arm
the arena is a macOS mmap prototype; nothing here is a cross-platform result

measurement.semantic: physical footprint and RSS of one host process sampled from outside; memory.report owners, libmalloc and arena statistics from inside; one target per cycle, 128 cycles per run
measurement.stress_semantic: allocator-stress.html is an allocator microbenchmark, not a page; its rows describe the allocator under that script and are judged apart from the browser workloads

rules.capacity: capacity-growth.html: realm live bytes at first OOM divided by 16 MiB, 1 warm-up + 7 runs
rules.late_growth: post_close footprint at cycle 128 minus at cycle 64
rules.reopen_cost: live footprint at a sample cycle minus post_close footprint at the previous sample cycle
rules.retained: post_close footprint minus the empty footprint of the same run
rules.slope: least-squares slope of post_close physical footprint over sample cycles >= 8, bytes per cycle
rules.stress: allocator-stress.html opened once per run (1 warm-up + 7 runs) and eight open/close cycles in one process; judged separately from the browser workloads
teardown_check_after_every_close: arena arm: allocator.arenas_unmapped == cycles closed so far
rules.trim: memory.trim on a live stress realm; the arena path only marks the free tail reusable and is reported as tail-only, never as close recovery
rules.use_per_cycle: target.snapshot (semantic, 64 nodes); on the interactive fixture also one revision-scoped click and a revision wait
